The product stream flowrate (stream s12) is 0.162 mol/s with a benzene purity of 89.51%, and the reactor volume required to achieve a conversion of 75% is 0.147 m³. However, stream s06 shows that a significant amount of benzene (0.149 mol/s or approximately 42% of the total benzene produced in the reactor R101) is exiting the flash separator, which suggests that the operating conditions could be changed such that the loss of benzene in the flash separator is minimized.
zh: 检查初始解：表 3 以物流表形式展示了仿真结果。由于在物流 10 处切换了物性包，状态变量也发生了变化，这一点体现在物流表中。产品物流 s12 的流量为 0.162 mol/s，苯纯度为 89.51%；达到 75% 转化率所需的反应器体积为 0.147 m³。然而，物流 s06 表明，有相当数量的苯离开了闪蒸分离器，流量为 0.149 mol/s，约占反应器 R101 中苯总生成量的 42%。这说明，可以改变操作条件，使闪蒸分离器中的苯损失最小化。

en: For the simulation case, with the initial operating conditions that were set, the total annual cost (sum of amortized capital and operating cost) is $442 201.
zh: 对于采用所设初始操作条件的仿真情形，总年成本，即摊销资本成本与运行成本之和，为 $442 201。

en: The EO approach used by the IDAES-CMF allows for quickly switching from solving a simulation problem to solving an optimization problem. In this case study, the total annual cost of the HDA process will be minimized, while enforcing certain performance constraints (minimum production and purity requirement, and limit product loss), by adjusting the following 7 decision variables:
zh: IDAES-CMF 所采用的 EO 方法支持从仿真问题求解快速切换至优化问题求解。在本案例中，通过调整以下 7 个决策变量，在满足一定性能约束，包括最低产量、纯度要求及产品损失限制的同时，使 HDA 过程的总年成本最小化：

en: Reactor pre-heater (H101) outlet temperature,
zh: 反应器预热器（H101）出口温度。

en: reactor (R101) cooling duty,
zh: 反应器（R101）冷却负荷。

en: light gas separator (F101) outlet temperature,
zh: 轻气体分离器（F101）出口温度。

en: distillation pre-heater (H102) outlet temperature, and
zh: 精馏预热器（H102）出口温度。

en: distillation column (C101) condenser pressure, reflux ratio and boilup ratio.
zh: 精馏塔（C101）冷凝器压力、回流比和再沸比。

en: 4.8 | Step 8: Define objective and remaining constraints
zh: 4.8 | 步骤 8：定义目标函数与其余约束

en: In addition to minimizing the total annualized cost, it is necessary to provide constraints on the final product, as well as a limit on the amount of benzene in the light gas stream leaving the flash separator. The following constraints are added to the process:
zh: 除了使总年化成本最小化，还需要对最终产品施加约束，并限制离开闪蒸分离器的轻气体物流中的苯量。向过程添加以下约束：

en: produce at least 0.18 mol/s of benzene in C101 distillate outlet (i.e. the benzene product stream s12),
zh: C101 馏出液出口，即苯产品物流 s12，至少产出 0.18 mol/s 的苯。

en: purity of benzene product is at least 99% in the product stream s12, and
zh: 产品物流 s12 中苯产品的纯度至少为 99%。

en: no more than 20% of the benzene entering the flash separator (F101) may leave in the light gas stream s06.
zh: 进入闪蒸分离器（F101）的苯中，随轻气体物流 s06 离开的比例不得超过 20%。

en: The first step is to add an objective function to the model using the Pyomo Objective component as shown in Figure 15, Lines 298 and 299. The goal is to minimize the sum of operating and capital costs, which have already been added to the flowsheet as Expressions. Unless otherwise specified, Pyomo assumes the goal is to minimize the objective function. Figure 15 also shows how to add constraints to the model to enforce the product flow rate, purity and benzene loss conditions, which is done using inequality constraints.
zh: 第一步是使用 Pyomo 的 Objective 组件向模型添加目标函数，如图 15 第 298 和 299 行所示。目标是使运行成本与资本成本之和最小化，这些成本此前已作为 Expression 添加到流程中。除非另作说明，Pyomo 默认对目标函数求最小值。图 15 还展示了如何向模型添加约束，以满足产品流量、纯度和苯损失条件；这些条件通过不等式约束实现。

en: 4.9 | Step 9: Unfix the operating conditions to create degrees of freedom for optimization
zh: 4.9 | 步骤 9：解除操作条件的固定，形成优化自由度

en: Next, the operating conditions can be converted to decision variables simply by unfixing their values, as shown in Figure 16 (lines 318 to 324). However, it is also necessary to set bounds on these variables to limit the search space available to the solver (lines 327 to 341). For this case study, the following bounds will be used:
zh: 接下来，只需解除操作条件数值的固定，就可将其转变为决策变量，如图 16 第 318 至 324 行所示。不过，还需要为这些变量设定边界，以限制求解器可探索的搜索空间（第 327 至 341 行）。本案例使用以下边界：

en: H101 outlet temperature [500, 600] K
R101 outlet temperature [600, 900] K
R101 volume lower bound of 0 m³ (no upper bound)
zh: R101 体积下界：0 m³，无上界。

en: F101 outlet temperature [298, 450] K
H102 outlet temperature [350, 400] K
C101 condenser pressure [101 325, 150 000] Pa
C101 reflux ratio [0.1, 5]
C101 boilup ratio [0.1, 5]
4.10 | Step 10: Perform optimization and inspect solution
zh: 4.10 | 步骤 10：执行优化并检查解

en: Thus, the flowsheet model is readily converted to an optimization problem. Since IPOPT was used to solve the flowsheet previously, the same solver can now be applied to solve the optimization problem as shown in line 344 of Figure 16. The optimization problem contains 1196 variables and 1189 constraints and solved in 42 iterations (0.91 s total, 0.18 s CPU time in IPOPT). Table 4 shows the stream table and results summary for the optimized process. As can be seen, the process met the increased product flowrate and purity demands of 0.18 mol/s at 99% purity. The optimization was also able to reduce the yearly operating cost by 4.5% from $427 511/yr. to $408 260/yr.; however, the amortized capital cost more than doubled from $14 690/yr. to $29 921/yr. due to the need to increase the conversion in the reactor (from 75% to 93%) to meet the increased production and purity constraints. The reactor volume required to achieve this conversion was 0.299 m³.
zh: 这样，流程模型便可方便地转化为优化问题。此前已使用 IPOPT 求解流程，现在可以使用同一求解器求解优化问题，如图 16 第 344 行所示。该优化问题包含 1196 个变量和 1189 个约束，经 42 次迭代求解完成，总耗时 0.91 s，其中 IPOPT 的 CPU 时间为 0.18 s。表 4 给出了优化后过程的物流表和结果汇总。可以看到，过程满足了提高后的产品流量和纯度要求，即 0.18 mol/s、纯度 99%。优化还使年运行成本降低了 4.5%，由 $427 511/yr. 降至 $408 260/yr.；然而，摊销资本成本增加了一倍以上，由 $14 690/yr. 增至 $29 921/yr.，原因是为了满足提高后的产量与纯度约束，需要将反应器转化率从 75% 提高到 93%。达到这一转化率所需的反应器体积为 0.299 m³。

en: Looking further into the results, it can be seen that some of the operating conditions have been pushed to their bounds. The product flow rate and purity are at the minimum values of 0.18 mol benzene/s and 99% which is expected as increasing recovery would require more energy (i.e. cost) to purify the product. The operating temperature of the flash separator (F101) has also been reduced to the lower bound in order to minimize the amount of benzene in the vapor stream, while the operating pressure for the distillation column is also at the lower bound, which will reduce the cooling costs required to achieve the target purity. The optimal reflux and boilup ratios in the distillation column (C101) are 0.801 and 1.135 respectively, which have changed from the initial values of 0.5.
zh: 进一步分析结果可以发现，某些操作条件已达到其边界。产品流量和纯度分别位于 0.18 mol 苯/s 和 99% 的下限，这符合预期，因为提高回收率需要消耗更多能量，也就是增加成本，以提纯产品。闪蒸分离器（F101）的操作温度也降至下界，以尽可能减少气相物流中的苯量；精馏塔的操作压力同样位于下界，这将降低达到目标纯度所需的冷却成本。精馏塔（C101）的最优回流比和再沸比分别为 0.801 和 1.135，相较于初始值 0.5 均发生了变化。

en: 4.11 | Step 11: Optimization under uncertainty
zh: 4.11 | 步骤 11：不确定性下优化

en: One of the key advantages of the IDAES-CMF is the ability to leverage the power of EO models along with the many useful libraries available as part of the Python Programming Language to quickly extend the analysis and visualization capabilities. Due to the flexibility and open nature of the framework that allows full access to the underlying equations, the IDAES-CMF is well-suited to extend a deterministic optimization model to related, and more complex, tasks including parameter estimation, optimization under uncertainty, data reconciliation, and conceptual design. To demonstrate this advanced capability, the deterministic optimization of the HDA case study will be extended to incorporate uncertainty in the kinetic parameters (denoted as $\theta$) by formulating a two-stage stochastic programming problem that minimizes the following objective: [[EQ13]] where $E_\theta()$ is the expected value over a probability distribution for the uncertain parameters $\theta$. The purpose here is to demonstrate the ease of setting up a stochastic program (or multi-scenario problem) within IDAES-CMF in Python and is not an extensive demonstration of stochastic programming itself.
zh: IDAES-CMF 的一个关键优势，是能够结合 EO 模型的能力与 Python 编程语言生态中众多有用的库，快速扩展分析和可视化能力。该框架灵活、开放，可完整访问底层方程，因此非常适合将确定性优化模型扩展至相关且更复杂的任务，包括参数估计、不确定性下优化、数据协调和概念设计。为展示这一高级能力，将 HDA 案例的确定性优化扩展为包含动力学参数不确定性的情形，这些参数记为 $\theta$；通过建立两阶段随机规划问题，使以下目标函数最小化： [[EQ13]] 其中，$E_\theta()$ 为对不确定参数 $\theta$ 的概率分布取期望。这里的目的是展示在 Python 中通过 IDAES-CMF 建立随机规划或多情景问题的便捷性，而不是对随机规划本身作全面展示。

en: For this example, a normal distribution will be assumed on the reaction kinetic parameters $\theta\sim N(\mu,\sigma^2)$, with the Arrhenius constant (μ= 6.3 × 10¹⁰, σ = 9450 × 10⁵) and the activation energy (μ = 217.6 × 10³, σ = 3264). To set up this problem, the rand function from the NumPy Python package can be used to create the normally distributed parameter values and number of scenarios (100 in this example) as shown in lines 2 and 9, respectively, in Figure 17. To create the two-stage stochastic problem, a new ConcreteModel object is created, called “m,” and then the (first-stage) design variable is declared, which is the reactor volume in this case. The second-stage decision variables, which differ in each scenario, are the outlet temperatures for H101, H102, F101 and R101 and the pressure, reflux and boilup ratios for C101. To set up the scenarios, the Python method get_opt_model() is used to return an instance of the deterministic optimization problem which was solved previously in step 10. This method is called for each of the 100 scenarios, and the model instance is attached to the ConcreteModel “m” that was created in line 12 in Figure 17. As each model instance is added, the rand function is used to assign values to the Arrhenius constant and the activation energy, as shown in lines 33 to 44 of Figure 17. A set of non-anticipativity constraints are then added to enforce the reactor volume to be the same across all scenarios (lines 47 and 48). The only remaining step setting up the problem is to deactivate the deterministic objective object (from lines 297–299 of Figure 15) and instead declare the objective expression for the stochastic problem as shown in lines 51–57 of Figure 17.
zh: 在本例中，假定反应动力学参数服从正态分布 $\theta\sim N(\mu,\sigma^2)$，其中阿伦尼乌斯常数的参数为 $\mu=6.3\times10^{10}$、$\sigma=9450\times10^5$，活化能的参数为 $\mu=217.6\times10^3$、$\sigma=3264$。为建立这一问题，可以使用 NumPy Python 包中的 `rand` 函数生成服从正态分布的参数值，并设置情景数量，本例为 100 个；相关内容分别见图 17 第 2 和第 9 行。为创建两阶段随机问题，首先新建名为 `m` 的 ConcreteModel 对象，然后声明第一阶段设计变量，本例为反应器体积。第二阶段决策变量在不同情景下取值不同，包括 H101、H102、F101 和 R101 的出口温度，以及 C101 的压力、回流比和再沸比。为设置各个情景，使用 Python 方法 `get_opt_model()`，返回此前在步骤 10 中已求解的确定性优化问题实例。对 100 个情景分别调用这一方法，并将模型实例附加到图 17 第 12 行创建的 ConcreteModel `m` 上。添加每个模型实例时，使用 `rand` 函数为阿伦尼乌斯常数和活化能赋值，如图 17 第 33 至 44 行所示。随后加入一组非预见性约束，强制所有情景中的反应器体积相同（第 47 和 48 行）。建立问题剩余的唯一步骤，是停用确定性目标对象，即图 15 第 297—299 行中的对象，改为声明随机问题的目标表达式，如图 17 第 51 至 57 行所示。

en: The resulting 2two-stage stochastic programming problem consists of 100 scenarios, 119 601 variables and 119 000 constraints and was solved with IPOPT in under 35 CPU seconds with an expected objective value of $438 467/yr. By incorporating the uncertainty in the kinetic parameters, the amortized capital cost marginally increased from $29 921/yr. to $30 029/yr. Figures 18 and 19 show the distribution of the operating cost and the optimal values of the operating variables for the scenarios considered. From the solution of the stochastic program, it can be seen that reactor volume increased only slightly (to 0.300 m³ from the deterministic solution volume of 0.299 m³). For comparison, the reactor volume from the deterministic solution would have resulted in four infeasible scenarios, shown in Table 5, in which the overhead loss constraint (which limits the benzene to 20% in the vapor stream of the flash separator) was violated due to reduced single-pass conversion in the reactor. This simple example of optimization problem under uncertainty, demonstrates how the IDAES-CMF can easily extend deterministic optimization models to allow stochastic optimization under uncertainty—in this case with less than 20 lines of code.
zh: 所得两阶段随机规划问题包含 100 个情景、119 601 个变量和 119 000 个约束，使用 IPOPT 在不到 35 CPU 秒内完成求解，目标函数期望值为 $438 467/yr.。纳入动力学参数的不确定性后，摊销资本成本略有增加，从 $29 921/yr. 增至 $30 029/yr.。图 18 和图 19 展示了所考虑情景中的运行成本分布及操作变量最优值的分布。随机规划解表明，反应器体积仅略微增大，从确定性解的 0.299 m³ 增至 0.300 m³。作为比较，若采用确定性解中的反应器体积，会出现表 5 所示的四个不可行情景；在这些情景中，由于反应器单程转化率降低，塔顶损失约束被违反，该约束使闪蒸分离器气相物流带走的苯不超过 20%。这个简单的不确定性下优化示例表明，IDAES-CMF 可以方便地将确定性优化模型扩展为不确定性下的随机优化；本例所需代码不到 20 行。

en: While the case study shown here is relatively simple, the IDAES-CMF has been applied to simulating and optimizing complex chemical and energy related processes, such as the removal of CO₂ from power plant flue gas.[38] The IDAES-CMF has also been applied to a range of other problem types, such as conceptual design and process intensification[39] and dynamic real-time optimization and control,[40] and non-linear robust optimization.[41]
zh: 虽然这里展示的案例相对简单，IDAES-CMF 已用于复杂化工和能源相关过程的仿真与优化，例如从电厂烟气中脱除 CO₂。[38] IDAES-CMF 还被用于其他多种问题，包括概念设计和过程强化、[39] 动态实时优化与控制，[40] 以及非线性鲁棒优化。[41]

en: 5 | CONCLUSION
zh: 5 | 结论

en: The IDAES Core Modeling Framework integrates mathematical optimization and simulation capabilities with libraries of equation-based models of unit operations and thermophysical properties and tools for editing and creating new models. The IDAES-CMF builds on the foundation of Pyomo,[27] an open-source, extensible algebraic modeling environment implemented in the Python programming language which provides direct access to state-of-the-art solvers, solution techniques and, through Python, access to numerous libraries for scientific computing, data analyses and visualization capabilities. This is combined with fully modifiable and extensible libraries of common processing unit operations and property calculations which enable a seamless transition between dynamic and steady-state modeling. The IDAES-CMF allows tight integration with advanced optimization-based approaches, such as conceptual design and optimization under uncertainty, to support the full process modeling lifecycle from process design to dynamic optimization and control within a single computational platform. With these capabilities, IDAES-CMF can be utilized to design novel processes and technologies for large scale complex systems, with more complete optimization studies than ever before.
zh: IDAES 核心建模框架将数学优化与仿真能力、基于方程的单元操作和热物性模型库，以及编辑和创建新模型的工具集成在一起。IDAES-CMF 建立在 Pyomo[27] 的基础上；Pyomo 是使用 Python 编程语言实现的开源、可扩展代数建模环境，可直接调用最先进的求解器和求解技术，并通过 Python 使用众多科学计算、数据分析和可视化库。该基础与完全可修改、可扩展的常见过程单元操作和物性计算库相结合，使动态建模与稳态建模之间能够无缝转换。IDAES-CMF 可与先进的优化方法紧密集成，例如概念设计和不确定性下优化，从而在单一计算平台上支持从过程设计到动态优化与控制的完整过程建模生命周期。凭借这些能力，IDAES-CMF 可用于大型复杂系统中新过程和新技术的设计，并开展比以往更全面的优化研究。

en: The IDAES-CMF has been demonstrated by applying it to model and optimize a flowsheet for the hydrodealkylation (HDA) of toluene to form benzene, which includes both chemical reactions and phase separation to separate benzene from toluene. The case study provides a simple demonstration of how the IDAES-CMF can be used to rapidly assemble an EO model of the process using a library of pre-built, reusable unit operation models and property packages. Furthermore, the case study demonstrates its capabilities for solving both deterministic and stochastic optimization problems. The HDA optimization example includes 7 degrees of freedom (total of 1173 variables and 1186 constraints), including the reflux and boilup ratios and operating pressure of the distillation column, demonstrating the ability of the framework to optimize a complex non-linear system. The case study also highlights the flexibility of the IDAES-CMF to include different levels of detail and rigor in different parts of the flowsheet by demonstrating how two different sets of property calculations and component lists can be included in the same flowsheet by assuming complete removal of hydrogen and methane from the liquid product stream prior to the distillation column. Moreover, the IDAES-CMF framework allows these optimization models to be extended in a very flexible manner to consider a variety of challenging optimization formulations. For instance, it was demonstrated that with less than 20 lines of python code, the HDA example can be readily extended to incorporate uncertainty through a two-stage stochastic program with 117 601 variables and 117 000 constraints while remaining computationally tractable and solving in under 35 CPU s.
zh: 通过对甲苯加氢脱烷基（HDA）制苯流程进行建模和优化，展示了 IDAES-CMF 的应用；该流程同时包含化学反应以及用于分离苯和甲苯的相分离。案例简单展示了如何利用预先构建、可复用的单元操作模型和物性包库，通过 IDAES-CMF 快速组装过程的 EO 模型。此外，案例展示了其求解确定性和随机优化问题的能力。HDA 优化示例包含 7 个自由度，总计 1173 个变量和 1186 个约束；自由度包括精馏塔的回流比、再沸比和操作压力，展示了框架优化复杂非线性系统的能力。案例还突出了 IDAES-CMF 在流程不同部分采用不同细节程度和严谨程度的灵活性：通过假定进入精馏塔之前，液体产物流中的氢气和甲烷已完全脱除，展示了如何在同一流程中包含两组不同的物性计算与组分列表。此外，IDAES-CMF 框架能够非常灵活地扩展这些优化模型，以考虑多种具有挑战性的优化数学形式。例如，文中展示了只需不到 20 行 Python 代码，就能方便地将 HDA 示例扩展为含 117 601 个变量和 117 000 个约束的两阶段随机规划，以纳入不确定性，同时保持计算上的可求解性，并在不到 35 CPU 秒内完成求解。
